**New Features** | **Bug Fixes** | | ##### **API v 8.8.4** | October 1, 2026 | | - Fixed an issue where numbers didn’t match between segments with no ANR errors vs querying the API for no ANR errors 

- Fix for numbers not matching between segments and regular filters

- Fix for segments inflating numbers on the traffic source and medium dashboard

- Updated a hard coded >20 check into a filter for the VitalScope table 

- Added missing Native filters to the errors endpoint | | ##### **Portal v10.8.3** | October 1, 2026 | - Added a site level switch to show/hide the session playback feature | - Fixed an issue where a data limit caused VitalScope selector counts to not show up in the table 

- Service Now integration works properly | | ##### Portal v10.7.3 | August 27, 2026 | - Updated to [CSP V3 - Documentation](https://help.bluetriangle.com/hc/en-us/articles/50207207697427) | - Fixed an issue with the Revenue Assurance table width.

- Fixed an issue with custom portal terms in Revenue Assurance. | | ##### API v8.7 | August 12, 2026 | - Support for OAuth was added | | | ##### Portal v10.7.1 | August 12, 2026 | - Support for OAuth was added | - Revenue Attribution campaign filter not applying correctly was resolved | | ##### API v8.6.1 | July 30 2026 | - Updates to support Page Name wildcard searches | | | ##### Portal v10.6.3 | July 30 2026 | - Added SPA support for pages when creating synthetic scripts 

- Updates to the filters to work better when selecting traffic segments 
- Added a radio button to change page name from IN (default behavior now) to CONTAINS (text input that allows a wildcard \* for matching)

- Added the page name counts attached to each traffic segment

- Added text under the traffic segment filter to show how many pages will show in the page name filter | - Fixed an issue with extra white space on some graphs

- Revenue Assurance Bug Fixes:
- Mobile View at normal zoom causes text trim on small tiles 

- Improve recommendation status UI updates and badge handling. Add optimistic status updates with immediate card/table/chart refresh, fix dynamic status badge styling, enhance Internal Review edit section behavior, and improve attachment section update handling

- Sorting ignores K and M 

- Star button not functioning

- Revenue Assurance Rec lost formatting when I edited and published it

- Wrong Apple Icon
- Clicking links from the VitalPulse dashboard was not carrying over all selected filters 

- Selecting a larger time period by default in the Performance Details scatterplot when looking at low page volume 

- Fixed an issue on the page name filter where selecting a traffic segment was not properly updating the list of page name | | ##### Portal v10.1.3 | February 25, 2026 | **Improvements**
- Added browser filter support to the Executive KPI report 

- Added the AI assistant to the Instant Measurement page

- Added a button on the Site Settings page to clear the tag’s cache

- Added LCP Page Views, INP Page Views, CLS Page Views, TTI Page Views, FDCP Page Views, and TBT Page Views to the Data Science Page | **Bug Fixes**
- Fixed an issue where Instant Measurements were sending an incorrectly formatted JSON to the API

- Fixed an issue where rejected domains were showing up under pending domains

- Fixed a couple issues with the accuracy of page view counts when doing sub groups on the Data Science page | Use table header to sort columns ## Cookie Preferences This site uses third-party website tracking technologies to provide and continually improve our services, and to display advertisements according to users interests.
